reason: An MCP adapter for DeepSeek Harness that provides lazy server connections, on-demand tool discovery and invocation, authentication, and Web/CLI configuration for external MCP services.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务适配，通过代理工具按需发现、描述和调用已配置的外部 MCP 服务。
summaries.en: An MCP adapter for DeepSeek Harness that enables on-demand discovery and invocation of configured external MCP services through a proxy tool.

capabilities: Searches, describes, and calls MCP tools on demand
Can launch configured local MCP server commands
Supports external service authentication including OAuth and bearer tokens
Writes or updates MCP configuration files through the Web interface and CLI
